sql: SELECT record_company FROM orchestra GROUP BY record_company ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT owners.first_name, owners.last_name, sizes.size_description
FROM owners
JOIN dogs ON owners.owner_id = dogs.owner_id
JOIN sizes ON dogs.size_code = sizes.size_code;
SELECT template_id, version_number, template_type_code FROM templates;
SELECT template_type_code, template_type_description FROM ref_template_types;

SELECT DISTINCT model_list.model  
FROM model_list  
JOIN car_names ON model_list.modelid = car_names.makeid  
JOIN cars_data ON car_names.id = cars_data.id  
WHERE cars_data.year > 1980;

SELECT makeid, maker 
FROM car_names 
WHERE makeid IN (
    SELECT makeid 
    FROM cars_data 
    WHERE cylinders < 4 
    AND horsepower > (
        SELECT MIN(horsepower) 
        FROM cars_data
    )
);
SELECT language FROM countrylanguage WHERE isofficial = 1 GROUP BY language ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT countrycode) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM highschooler;
SELECT model FROM model_list GROUP BY model ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT maker) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pets WHERE weight > 10;
SELECT age, hometown FROM teacher;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pets WHERE weight > 10;

SELECT v.id, v.name, v.age
FROM visitor v
JOIN visit vis ON v.id = vis.visitor_id
GROUP BY v.id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vis.museum_id) > 1;
SELECT money_rank FROM poker_player WHERE people_id = (SELECT people_id FROM people ORDER BY height DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE contid IN (SELECT DISTINCT continent FROM car_makers GROUP BY continent HAVING COUNT(*) > 2);

SELECT DISTINCT tv_channel.series_name, tv_channel.country FROM tv_channel JOIN cartoon ON tv_channel.id = cartoon.channel WHERE cartoon.directed_by = 'Ben Jones' OR cartoon.directed_by = 'Michael Chang';
SELECT name FROM teacher WHERE age = 32 OR age = 33;

SELECT DISTINCT t.template_type_description
FROM ref_template_types t
JOIN templates tp ON t.template_type_code = tp.template_type_code
JOIN documents d ON tp.template_id = d.template_id
JOIN paragraphs p ON d.document_id = p.document_id;
SELECT location, COUNT(*) AS number_of_shops FROM shop GROUP BY location;
SELECT paragraphs.paragraph_id, paragraphs.paragraph_text FROM paragraphs JOIN documents ON paragraphs.document_id = documents.document_id WHERE documents.document_name = 'Welcome to NY';
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS count FROM people GROUP BY nationality;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE cylinders > 4;
SELECT semester_name FROM semesters WHERE semester_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT semester_id FROM student_enrolment);
SELECT manager_name, district FROM shop ORDER BY number_products DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(weight) FROM pets WHERE pettype = 'dog';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT degree_summary_name) FROM degree_programs;
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM players WHERE hand = 'L' ORDER BY birth_date;
SELECT title FROM cartoon ORDER BY title;
SELECT DISTINCT year FROM cars_data WHERE weight >= 3000 AND weight <= 4000;

SELECT document_id
FROM paragraphs
GROUP BY document_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM tv_channel WHERE country NOT IN (SELECT country FROM tv_series JOIN cartoon ON tv_series.channel = cartoon.channel WHERE cartoon.written_by = 'Todd Casey');
SELECT DISTINCT fname FROM student WHERE stuid IN (SELECT stuid FROM has_pet WHERE petid IN (SELECT petid FROM pets WHERE pettype IN ('cat', 'dog')));
SELECT fname, age FROM student WHERE stuid IN (SELECT stuid FROM has_pet);

SELECT shop.name, COUNT(hiring.shop_id) AS num_employees
FROM shop
LEFT JOIN hiring ON shop.shop_id = hiring.shop_id
GROUP BY shop.shop_id;
SELECT section_name FROM sections ORDER BY section_name DESC;

SELECT s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name, s.student_id
FROM students s
JOIN student_enrolment se ON s.student_id = se.student_id
JOIN semesters sem ON se.semester_id = sem.semester_id
GROUP BY s.student_id, sem.semester_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT se.degree_program_id) = 2;

SELECT area_code
FROM votes
WHERE contestant_number = (
    SELECT contestant_number
    FROM contestants
    WHERE contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
)
AND state IN (
    SELECT state
    FROM votes
    WHERE contestant_number = (
        SELECT contestant_number
        FROM contestants
        WHERE contestant_name = 'Kelly Clauss'
    )
)
AND contestant_number = (
    SELECT contestant_number
    FROM contestants
    WHERE contestant_name = 'Kelly Clauss'
)
GROUP BY area_code;
SELECT tv_channel.series_name, tv_channel.country FROM tv_channel JOIN cartoon ON tv_channel.id = cartoon.channel WHERE cartoon.directed_by = 'Ben Jones' OR cartoon.directed_by = 'Michael Chang';

SELECT ref_template_types.template_type_code
FROM ref_template_types
LEFT JOIN templates ON ref_template_types.template_type_code = templates.template_type_code
LEFT JOIN documents ON templates.template_id = documents.template_id
WHERE documents.document_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dogs WHERE dog_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT dog_id FROM treatments);

SELECT countries.countryname 
FROM countries 
JOIN car_makers ON countries.contid = car_makers.country 
GROUP BY countries.countryname 
ORDER BY COUNT(car_makers.id) DESC 
LIMIT 1;
SELECT zip_postcode FROM addresses WHERE city = 'Port Chelsea';
SELECT AVG(loser_age) AS avg_loser_age, AVG(winner_age) AS avg_winner_age FROM matches;
SELECT first_name, birth_date FROM players WHERE country_code = 'USA';

SELECT treatment_type_description FROM treatment_types JOIN treatments ON treatment_types.treatment_type_code = treatments.treatment_type_code GROUP BY treatment_type_code ORDER BY SUM(cost_of_treatment) ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_code) FROM players;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE horsepower > 150;

SELECT semester_id, semester_name
FROM semesters
WHERE semester_id = (
    SELECT semester_id
    FROM student_enrolment
    GROUP BY semester_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT c.name, c.surfacearea
FROM country c
ORDER BY c.surfacearea DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher;

SELECT DISTINCT fname FROM student WHERE stuid IN (SELECT stuid FROM has_pet WHERE petid IN (SELECT petid FROM pets WHERE pettype = 'cat') INTERSECT SELECT stuid FROM has_pet WHERE petid IN (SELECT petid FROM pets WHERE pettype = 'dog'));
SELECT DISTINCT country FROM tv_channel JOIN cartoon ON tv_channel.id = cartoon.channel WHERE written_by = 'Todd Casey';
SELECT name, capacity FROM stadium WHERE average = (SELECT MAX(average) FROM stadium);

SELECT ref_template_types.template_type_code, COUNT(templates.template_id) AS number_of_templates
FROM ref_template_types
LEFT JOIN templates ON ref_template_types.template_type_code = templates.template_type_code
GROUP BY ref_template_types.template_type_code;
SELECT birth_year, citizenship FROM singer;
SELECT * FROM paragraphs WHERE paragraph_text LIKE 'Korea%';
SELECT name FROM country WHERE indepyear > 1950;

SELECT departments.department_id, departments.department_name
FROM departments
JOIN degree_programs ON departments.department_id = degree_programs.department_id
GROUP BY departments.department_id
ORDER BY COUNT(degree_programs.degree_program_id) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT money_rank FROM poker_player WHERE earnings = (SELECT MAX(earnings) FROM poker_player);
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS num_singers FROM singer GROUP BY country;

SELECT contestants.contestant_number, contestants.contestant_name
FROM contestants
JOIN votes ON contestants.contestant_number = votes.contestant_number
GROUP BY contestants.contestant_number
HAVING COUNT(votes.vote_id) >= 2;
SELECT SUM(bonus) FROM evaluation;
SELECT petid, weight FROM pets WHERE pet_age > 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT location) FROM shop;
SELECT title, directed_by FROM cartoon ORDER BY original_air_date;
SELECT grade FROM highschooler;
SELECT first_name, country_code FROM players JOIN rankings ON players.player_id = rankings.player_id GROUP BY players.player_id ORDER BY MAX(tours) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MIN(version_number), template_type_code FROM templates GROUP BY template_type_code;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_id) FROM visit WHERE museum_id NOT IN (SELECT museum_id FROM museum WHERE open_year > 2010);
SELECT document_id FROM paragraphs GROUP BY document_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
SELECT first_name, country_code, birth_date FROM players WHERE player_id = (SELECT winner_id FROM matches ORDER BY winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT name FROM employee ORDER BY age ASC;

SELECT country_code, first_name FROM players WHERE player_id IN (SELECT winner_id FROM matches WHERE tourney_name LIKE 'WTA Championships' AND round = 'Final' INTERSECT SELECT winner_id FROM matches WHERE tourney_name LIKE 'Australian Open' AND round = 'Final');
SELECT country_code FROM players GROUP BY country_code HAVING COUNT(*) > 50;
SELECT grade FROM highschooler GROUP BY grade ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT name FROM people WHERE people_id NOT IN (SELECT people_id FROM poker_player);

SELECT ref_template_types.template_type_code
FROM ref_template_types
JOIN templates ON ref_template_types.template_type_code = templates.template_type_code
GROUP BY ref_template_types.template_type_code
HAVING COUNT(templates.template_id) < 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents JOIN templates ON documents.template_id = templates.template_id WHERE templates.template_type_code = 'PPT';
SELECT name, level_of_membership FROM visitor WHERE level_of_membership > 4 ORDER BY age DESC;
SELECT DISTINCT name FROM singer JOIN song ON singer.singer_id = song.singer_id WHERE sales > 300000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dog_id) FROM treatments;
SELECT maker, id FROM car_makers WHERE id IN (SELECT maker FROM model_list GROUP BY maker HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AND id IN (SELECT id FROM car_makers GROUP BY id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3);
SELECT country, COUNT(*) as num_channels FROM tv_channel GROUP BY country ORDER BY num_channels DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT year FROM concert GROUP BY year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer;

SELECT citizenship
FROM singer
WHERE birth_year < 1945
  AND birth_year > 1955;

SELECT DISTINCT maker FROM car_makers WHERE id IN (SELECT makeid FROM car_names WHERE model IN (SELECT model FROM model_list WHERE maker = car_makers.id) AND id IN (SELECT id FROM cars_data WHERE year = 1970));
SELECT name FROM employee JOIN evaluation ON employee.employee_id = evaluation.employee_id GROUP BY employee.employee_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(num_of_staff) FROM museum WHERE open_year < 2009;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE year = 1980;

SELECT language 
FROM countrylanguage 
GROUP BY language 
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT countrycode) DESC 
LIMIT 1;
SELECT players.first_name || ' ' || players.last_name AS full_name FROM players WHERE players.hand = 'L' ORDER BY players.birth_date;

SELECT o.owner_id, o.zip_code
FROM owners o
JOIN dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
JOIN charges c ON d.dog_id = c.charge_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id
ORDER BY SUM(c.charge_amount) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT city
FROM employee
WHERE age < 30
GROUP BY city
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT template_id
FROM documents
GROUP BY template_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT document_id) > 1;
SELECT address_id, line_1, line_2 FROM addresses WHERE address_id = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE current_address_id = addresses.address_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT v.name FROM visitor v WHERE v.level_of_membership > 4 ORDER BY v.level_of_membership DESC;
